news_list.title: Revival 0.2.1
news_list.short_description: Monsters on town streets, Season 1 quest fixes, bags, real weather and Save Data backups.
news_list.content:
What changed since 0.1.0:

NEW
- Monsters on town streets. Places for monsters, herbs, nests and quests are now shared between paths, parks, woods, water and streets, instead of the nearest park or wood taking everything. Towns get about 19-24 places per map cell instead of 7-14, most of them on streets.
- A map cell can hold up to 48 places and 36 monsters.
- Bags are back. Thorstein sells five, once each (Equipment, Items): Bag and Small pouch +50 slots (500 orens each), Medium-sized pouch +100 (1000), Spacious pouch +200 (2000), Set of saddlebags +400 (4000). The inventory starts at 200 and stops at 1000.
- A full bag refuses shop items and herbs, and leaves extra fight and nest loot behind. Story, task, level-up and crafting rewards always arrive.
- Real weather where you play, from Open-Meteo. Only your position rounded to about 11 km is sent.
- This What's new page works, and shows each update's notes first.
- Season 1 quests unlock in order: Evil Never Sleeps and To the Rescue after A Joint Venture; Pride Ain't Cheap, The Dark Side of the Full Moon and What Lurks in the Nemeta after Good Money; The Sins of Our Fathers after Pride Ain't Cheap, then The Great Mushrooming; Will o' the Wisp after What Lurks in the Nemeta; Intruder after the five main quests.
- Monster Slayer opens as in the original: after Good Money, beat a rock troll, then lose to rock trolls 3 times until the troll talks. The quest shows the next time you start the game.
- Real timers: Vesemir wakes 12 hours after the remedy, and the mushroom contest lasts 24 hours.
- All 25 trinkets are in (12 new). Progress you already made counts.
- Quest rewards changed. Final Exam: none. Winged Bandit: 250 XP, 45 orens. A Joint Venture: 275 XP. Good Money: 250 XP, 40 orens. Pride Ain't Cheap: adds Necrophage Oil and a Grapeshot. Sword in the Stone: 150 XP and Dawnbringer. Will o' the Wisp: 250 XP and 100 orens at the treasure. Monster Slayer: 300 XP, plus 35 orens or the grey stones. The Sins of Our Fathers: 60 orens, and 750 XP with Hermit's Armor for lifting the curse. Intruder: 2000 XP and 100 orens on every ending. Endings you already reached keep what they paid.
- In the companion app: a Tuning page in the dashboard (monsters, places, experience, loot, herbs, nest gold, bag size, weather), Debug tools for testing, Save Data backup and restore, Send a report and Report on GitHub, installing the game from APKMirror, map downloads that resume, and Update the game.

FIXED
- Will o' the Wisp: the black screen at the stump, and the treasure chest that stayed open. Stuck at the chest? Tap it again.
- The leshen hound and the tracks show as search circles (they drew nothing).
- The Great Mushrooming: a mushroom appears beside you after every 200 m you walk, as in the original (track the quest to see them). The forktail pays its 50 orens.
- Sword in the Stone: Lothar's map is there from Good Money on, and Lothar also sells it for 500 orens.
- Intruder: all eight endings finish the quest.
- The Sins of Our Fathers is offered after Pride Ain't Cheap.
- Quest givers stand where you can see them.
- Permanent effects like the curse no longer count down to 1970.
- Kienan (To the Rescue) meets you while you walk.
- Alchemy: Add Station lists the stations again.
- Walking dailies pay when you claim them.
- Wolven Armor shows its real 50% bonus.
- Fewer crashes: the game no longer crashes on some Android 12 and newer phones, Android no longer closes it in the background for CPU use, and the server and map use far less memory.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Your bag holds 200 items until you buy bags. Already carrying more? You get no fight loot until you buy a bag or use some items up.
- New quests and moved quest givers show after you restart the game.
- Restoring Save Data replaces your progress: stop the server in the companion app first.

Thanks to MasterpiecePL for the memory and Android 12 fixes. Weather data by Open-Meteo.com. Map data from OpenStreetMap contributors. Questions and reports: join our Discord from the companion app.
